name: Princess Heart Link ~Kenki-tachi no Enbu~
original_name: プリンセスハートリンク～剣姫たちの艶舞～
source:
"Princess Heart Link"
The new game uses the most advanced virtual reality and nano technology. One can experience what it is like really living in a fantasy world. It is the latest MMORPG that is extremely popular. 

It's a legendary game where not only the visuals are real, but you can reach out and interact with countless objects and people.

The main character, Tsukasa Minato, is a boy in his first year of St. Trea high school.

He made a big decision to cure his shyness and just started playing "Princess Heart Link", which has a reputation for interacting people with ease.

What kind of adventure will Tsukasa have in this game world and what kind of love will he have ?
